name: Piyush Bhagat
player_statement:
A complete player, Piyush Bhagat has made a big mark in cricket. With 23 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 33, with an average of 8.11 and a quick strike rate of 50.83. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 25 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 98.1 overs, taking 15 wickets at an economy rate of 8.46. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
